workItems.title: Document architectural comparison and feature gap matrix against openai/codex-plugin-cc
acceptance: Perform a comprehensive architectural comparison between openai/codex-plugin-cc and the codex-cc-agy-grok polyglot repository.
Document the feature parity matrix covering slash commands, execution models (daemon broker vs CLI exec), isolation sandboxes, and session hooks.
Detail the architectural advantages and trade-offs of the symmetrical polyglot bridge vs the dedicated single-target companion.

workItems.title: Specify stop-review-gate hook and session lifecycle parity with openai/codex-plugin-cc
acceptance: Analyze the stop-review-gate hook from openai/codex-plugin-cc and compare it with the repository's session hooks.
Design an actionable specification to integrate stop-review-gate capabilities across polyglot agent connectors.
Define validation criteria, trigger conditions, bypass mechanisms, and schema constraints for pre-stop review gates.

workItems.title: Evaluate Codex app-server broker daemon protocol vs batch CLI exec
acceptance: Evaluate the JSON-RPC app-server protocol used by openai/codex-plugin-cc against the batch CLI exec architecture.
Compare latency, persistent session management, streaming responses, and process lifecycle.
Produce a specification for an optional app-server broker adapter in src/lib/provider.mjs compatible with the polyglot connector interface.

workItems.title: Map prompt engineering skills and session transfer compatibility
acceptance: Compare upstream prompt engineering guidelines, recipes, and antipatterns with current connector prompt composition.
Analyze session context transfer (/codex:transfer) compared to handoff mechanisms in src/lib/transfer.mjs.
Define recommendations for harmonizing prompt templates and subagent skills across all connectors.

workItems.title: Update PROJECT.md with comparative audit findings and upstream alignment milestones
acceptance: Update PROJECT.md with findings from the openai/codex-plugin-cc comparative analysis.
Add roadmap milestones for upstream feature alignment while maintaining existing polyglot parity.
Verify that repository validation and test suites continue to pass with zero failures.
